import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[7]
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*v + params[3]*x*np.abs(x) + params[4]*x**3
            + params[5]*v*t + params[6]*np.cos(w*t) + params[8]*np.sin(w*t) + params[9]*v*np.cos(w*t))
